svg.title: Terminal uwu-neofetch typing loop
svg.desc: Terminal-style SVG animation. The command dAd0qbu types first, then the uwu-neofetch anime art and profile text appear with typing effects. The final frame holds for about four seconds and loops. Source art: blyxyas/uwu-neofetch-art colored/anime-uwu.txt.

g.text: • Studying in University of Information Technology - VNUHCM
• Living in Thu Duc, Ho Chi Minh City
